G01.notes: Three goals have evidence in two distinct aligned-column classifications, a student-built topology, rotation, concept responses and original explanations; no mastery inferred from completion.

G02.notes: Two comparisons contrast illustrative close ancestry with similar swimming form. Build one topology and rotate it; no repetitive identical trials. Supplied traits/outgroup are distinguished from student inference.

G03.notes: OpenStax 20.1/20.2 and primary Nikaido et al. (1999) read. Constructed DNA differences are accurate and explicitly synthetic. Real whale/hippo ancestry rests on independent research; no generic fewest-differences rule, ancestor-tip ladder or dates from unscaled branches.

G04.notes: Invented rows, supplied outgroup, limited taxa, convergent form, short-sequence/rate limits, unscaled branch length, body scale and rotation equivalence are stated at relevant steps and in resources/reports.

G05.notes: Students classify corresponding actual base positions, place living cards at branch tips, revise an incorrect tree and rotate sibling branches. Changes are visible and recorded; navigation alone does not supply evidence.
